intro: Zevrost is an orc warlock trainer secluded within the subterranean Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. He mentors developing warlocks of the Horde, guiding them through the hazardous disciplines of fel magic, summoning rituals, and binding dark artifacts.

p: Tucked away deep in the caverns of the Cleft of Shadow, Zevrost is one of the principal mentors for Horde warlocks residing in Thrall's capital. While the broader orcish society remains wary of fel energies following the demonic corruption of their past, practitioners like Zevrost are tolerated under strict watch. He instills in his pupils the harsh discipline required to command demonic forces without succumbing to their corruptive nature, asserting that the fel only ruins those lacking inner strength.

Beyond basic instruction in spells and curses, Zevrost acts as a conduit for more ambitious dark undertakings. Initiates seeking advanced implements—such as the Orb of Orahil or the means to summon a fiery Felsteed—frequently pass through his hands. He directs aspirational practitioners to other masters of the craft, such as Menara Voidrender in the Barrens, ensuring that those who wield shadow magic push their capabilities to their absolute limits.
